Business_Rule: Models simulate intensity; Maps store spatial results.
Assets are contained within spatial units.
Assets share a vulnerability framework taxonomy.
Frameworks are composed of multiple dimensions.
Dimensions define the logic of the structure.
Hazardous events are documented in disaster records.
Loss is explained by an attribution link.
Link attributes loss to a slow-onset driver.
Options are evaluated via appraisal events.
Options are implemented as specific projects.
Projects are justified by a risk baseline.
Results feed back to improve resilience/risk scores.
Stakeholder appetite guides the decision context.
Projects are supported by various funding origins.
Media is grounded in raw evidence submissions.
Consultant outputs link to their raw evidence data.
